cues: Vertical storage keeps frequently used volumes from disappearing beneath papers on a crowded desk.
Grouping titles by subject turns browsing into a quick route from a question to relevant reading.
Spines displayed at eye level help visitors discover authors they might not have sought out.
A tiered arrangement can reserve prominent positions for prized editions or newly chosen reading.
Keeping picture books within a child's reach encourages independent choices during quiet play.
Seasonal cookbooks arranged together can spark menu ideas before the week's meals are planned.
